correctness.rationale: The Fourier eigenmodes of angular generator L are 0 on constants, (-gamma+in omega) on nonconstants; the isolated principal eigenvalue of L+k v cos(theta) is analytic near zero. Its Fourier recurrence shows that modes |n|<=2 suffice through k^4: a2=1/[2(1+w²)] and a4=(3w⁴−10w²−1)/[8(1+w²)^3(1+4w²)]. I independently rederived and symbolically simplified both coefficients. Multiplying the k^4 coefficient by 4! and dimensional factors gives 3v^4/gamma^3 times rational expression, while Gaussian Brownian translation adds D k² and no κ4. Polynomial 3w⁴−10w²−1 has precisely one nonnegative squared-root solution u=(5+2sqrt7)/3, establishing sign reversal. The spectral-gap cumulant expansion applies at fixed parameters as t→∞; it gives no fixed-time sign statement at the critical w.
